title: Smooth radial cutoff with ζ = 1 on B_{ρ/2}(ξ), ζ = 0 off B°_ρ(ξ), and |Dζ| <= 3/ρ
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ξ : Rn m) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∃ ζ : Rn m → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ζ x ∧ ζ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall ξ (ρ / 2), ζ x = 1) ∧ (∀ x, ρ ≤ dist x ξ → ζ x = 0) ∧ ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ x‖ ≤ 3 / ρ
